excerpt_i18n.en: On May 18, Baidu released its Q1 2026 financial report, showing total quarterly revenue of 32.1 billion yuan. Baidu's core business revenue reached 26 billion yuan, up 2% year-over-year, exceeding market expectations. AI business revenue accounted for 13.6 billion yuan, representing 52% of Baidu's core business revenue, and has grown for multiple consecutive quarters. "In Q1, AI business revenue exceeded half of Baidu's core business revenue for the first time, indicating that AI has become Baidu's core growth driver," said Robin Li, Baidu's founder. "Driven by surging enterprise demand and our differentiated full-stack AI capabilities built over the years, AI cloud revenue has shown strong growth momentum. Baidu's AI applications continue to expand their influence among enterprises and individuals, further validating the commercial potential of Baidu's AI innovations. Meanwhile, Apollo Go has maintained triple-digit growth in fully driverless ride-hailing trips and continues to advance its international expansion. We believe AI will bring greater value to Baidu in the coming quarters." Full-stack AI capabilities stand out, with AI cloud growing 79% year-over-year. During the quarter, Baidu AI Cloud revenue reached 8.8 billion yuan, up 79% year-over-year; GPU cloud revenue grew 184% year-over-year. Baidu Intelligent Cloud has been fully upgraded to a new full-stack AI cloud for large-scale agent applications, with comprehensive advancements in Agent Infra and AI Infra capabilities, further strengthening end-to-end coordination from underlying computing power to agent applications, providing a solid foundation for agent development. In terms of computing hardware, Kunlun Core P800 has completed large-scale validation, delivering multiple 10,000-card clusters.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de mayo, Baidu publicó los resultados financieros del primer trimestre de 2026, que muestran unos ingresos totales trimestrales de 32.100 millones de yuanes. Los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu alcanzaron los 26.000 millones de yuanes, un aumento interanual del 2%, superando las expectativas del mercado. De ellos, los ingresos del negocio de IA fueron de 13.600 millones de yuanes, lo que representa el 52% de los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu, y han crecido durante varios trimestres consecutivos. "En el primer trimestre, los ingresos del negocio de IA de Baidu superaron por primera vez la mitad de los ingresos del negocio general, lo que indica que la IA se ha convertido en el motor central de Baidu", afirmó Robin Li, fundador de Baidu. "Impulsados por el aumento de la demanda empresarial y las capacidades diferenciadas de IA de pila completa que hemos desarrollado durante años, los ingresos de la nube de IA han mostrado un fuerte impulso de crecimiento. Las aplicaciones de IA de Baidu continúan en el ámbito empresarial".
